description: This Java class 'TreeUriScannerIntentService' handles asynchronous scanning of removable storage devices using Android's Storage Access Framework. It searches directories for signed index files, verifies JAR signatures, and manages repository registration within the F-Droid app.

classes.name: TreeUriScannerIntentService
classes.description: Handles scanning of storage URIs, directory traversal, signature verification, and repository registration.

methods.name: scan
methods.description: Starts the scanning process for a given URI.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles activity result, grants URI permissions, and initiates scanning.

methods.name: onHandleWork
methods.description: Processes the intent to perform directory search.

methods.name: searchDirectory
methods.description: Recursively searches directories for signed index files.

methods.name: registerRepo
methods.description: Registers a repository based on the found index file.

methods.name: registerRepo (static)
methods.description: Fetches repository preview and starts AddRepoActivity.

methods.name: getSigningCertFromJar
methods.description: Verifies JAR signature and retrieves signing certificate.
